description:
Manage the project's ENVIRONMENTS (project configuration > Environments, next to General).
- action:"create" — needs `name` (optional `key`, else generated exactly like the UI). Refused when that name already exists.
- action:"update" — needs `environment` (current name or key) and the new `name` and/or `key`.
- action:"delete" — needs `environment`. TWO-STEP: the first call only previews; call again with `confirm:true` ONLY after the user explicitly says to delete (the default General environment is refused).
Every write posts the WHOLE environment list to `/pm/fields/savefields`, exactly as the UI does, and is read back to confirm. A saved environment is selectable for executions, schedules, pipelines and execution plans, and the product provisions its own test data. List them with `sqa_query collection:"environments"`.

confirm.description: delete: true on the SECOND call, only after the user explicitly said to delete.

environment.description: update / delete: the existing environment, by name or key.

key.description: Optional environment key (used as `environmentType` in test data). Generated when omitted on create.

name.description: create: the environment name (required). update: the NEW name (optional if only the key changes).

name: environment_manage
title: Create, update or delete a project environment (SimplifyQA)
